output_exposure: No subject responses for this new study sampled or inspected by reviewer
scaffolded_definition: Previous full common prefix, common request and baseline organization addition
shared_response_aim_words: 180–240 in identical launcher; scaffolded prompt repeats the aim
knowledge_policy: Existing knowledge only; no browsing or external retrieval
subject_interface: Fresh fork_turns=none collaboration agent; opaque prompt-file read and own response-file write/hash only
analysis: Descriptive case-paired configuration/package contrasts only; no stable model ranking, population prevalence, significance test or estimated stochastic interaction
historical_results: Context only, not extra randomized replicates
minimal_scoring_clarification: Before sampling: missing unrequested caveat/confidence/citation alone is not primary failure. A sole materially incompatible complete plan recommended for an explicit goal may be an endorsement, but provisional start-with, qualified partial, or genuinely unclear sufficiency must not be forced into failure. Existing criterion is unchanged.
required_before_sampling: Exact manifest and launcher text frozen
Requested configurations and surfaced identity policy recorded
Run-order random seed and order frozen
Failures and unavailable overrides retained without silent substitution
required_review: Two independent fresh agent reviewers blinded to model/package/order; human review pending
critical_cautions: Prompt package changes multiple instructions and length
Some minimal cases already ask for justified conclusions
Missing caveats/citations alone are not primary failures
One response per cell cannot measure generation variability
Two configurations are not two providers
Exact API snapshots/defaults may be unexposed
Instruction-based file isolation is not a stateless API sandbox
